fact: The national 7-77 digital programme, launched in July 2026 by the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications, had over 150,000 registrations and 40 online sessions with 1,166 participants by 9 August 2026, when in-person sessions for 600 people began at Algérie Télécom Skills Centers.
title: Algérie Télécom lance les premières sessions présentielles du programme national 7-77
